subject: Television & Streaming
title: Michael Scott: The Boss Nobody Wanted
description: A quick, practical guide to Michael Scott: The Boss Nobody Wanted.

hook.text: Michael Scott was an incompetent boss who desperately wanted his employees to love him.

buildup.text: Michael said inappropriate things constantly. He made every situation about himself. His neediness was painful to watch.

twist.text: When Michael left in season seven, audiences cried.

climax.text: Michael Scott proved that cringe comedy works best when the character earns empathy.

punchline.text: The worst boss on TV became the one everyone misses most.

quiz.question: What made Michael Scott's departure from The Office so emotional for audiences?
options: Years of cringe comedy had built genuine empathy, making viewers love the character they once cringed at
